channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Gino & Marty’s Skirts Eviction In Fulton Market Despite Debt And Legal Troubles
item.description: The closed Randolph Street restaurant settled a rent dispute but faces other lawsuits, including over unpaid wages. Owner Gino Bartucci has hinted at reopening but would need a new state liquor license.

item.title: 20 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: River Dyeing, Fruit Tree Giveaway, 312 Day Celebration
item.description: A breakdancing workshop, a children's choir performance and a moms' dance party are also on deck.

item.title: Cubs Want Hundreds Of New Parking Spaces Near Wrigley Field
item.description: Cubs officials say the additional spaces could reduce parking for fans on neighborhood streets, but residents fear the expansion will bring more gridlock on game days.

item.title: The Austin Voice Newspaper Returns To Print, 9 Months After Founder’s Death
item.description: The West Side weekly went on hiatus after editor Brad Cummings died in a fire. Isaac Lewis, publisher of North Lawndale Community News, is bringing it back on a twice-monthly schedule, starting Friday.

item.title: Chicago River Swim Returns This September — With 500 More Swimmers
item.description: The Sept. 20 race will raise money for ALS research at Northwestern University, as well as swimming education and water safety programming for youth.

item.title: How 7 Families Celebrate The South Side Irish Parade, From Breakfast With Politicos To A Backyard Mass
item.description: While the parade draws thousands to Western Avenue, hundreds more people spend the day at neighborhood house parties that have been hosted for decades.

item.title: Stony Island Redesign, Transit Upgrades Pitched For South Shore Corridor Improvement Plan
item.description: A city-commissioned panel has been tasked with coming up with ideas to establish Stony Island "as a hub for retail, entertainment, tourism and higher education."

item.title: State’s Attorney Turned ‘Blind Eye’ To ICE Abuses, Petition Calling For Special Prosecutor Says
item.description: Nearly 250 people back a petition they say is needed because Cook County State's Attorney Eileen O'Neill Burke has failed to act. O'Neill Burke called demands for a special prosecutor "frivolous" and that she "will strenuously oppose this petition."

item.title: GoFundMe Launched For Hubbard Inn Security Guard Who Died After Being Pushed Down Stairs
item.description: Bryan Christopher Watson, 35, was trying to break up a fight at the River North bar and restaurant, police said. His family is raising $16,000 to help with funeral costs.

item.title: Feds Dropping Cases Against 2 Of The 6 Broadview Protesters Charged With Conspiracy
item.description: Prosecutors have moved to drop the charges against Cat Sharp, a 40th Ward staffer and former candidate for Cook County Board Commissioner, and musician Jocelyn Walsh.
